concepts.name: Atomic Theory
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: The structure of the atom: protons, neutrons, electrons, and atomic models.
learning_objectives: Describe atomic structure and predict basic properties from atomic number.

concepts.name: Periodic Trends
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Trends in atomic radius, electronegativity, and ionization energy across the periodic table.
learning_objectives: Predict periodic trends in atomic properties from an element's position on the table.

concepts.name: Chemical Bonding
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Ionic, covalent, and metallic bonding, and molecular geometry.
learning_objectives: Predict bond type and basic molecular geometry from electronegativity differences.

concepts.name: Moles and Stoichiometry
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: The mole concept and quantitative relationships in chemical reactions.
learning_objectives: Perform stoichiometric calculations to relate reactant and product quantities.

concepts.name: Gas Laws
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: The ideal gas law and the relationships between pressure, volume, and temperature.
learning_objectives: Apply the ideal gas law to relate pressure, volume, temperature, and moles of gas.

concepts.name: Thermochemistry
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Energy changes in chemical reactions and Hess's law.
learning_objectives: Apply Hess's law to calculate enthalpy changes for chemical reactions.

concepts.name: Reaction Kinetics
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Reaction rates, rate laws, and the factors that influence reaction speed.
learning_objectives: Derive a rate law from experimental concentration-time data.

concepts.name: Chemical Equilibrium
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Dynamic equilibrium, the equilibrium constant, and Le Chatelier's principle.
learning_objectives: Apply Le Chatelier's principle to predict the effect of a disturbance on equilibrium.

concepts.name: Acids and Bases
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Bronsted-Lowry and Lewis definitions of acids and bases, and pH.
learning_objectives: Classify substances as acids or bases and relate pH to hydrogen ion concentration.

concepts.name: pH and Buffer Systems
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: How buffer solutions resist changes in pH.
learning_objectives: Calculate the pH of a buffer solution using the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation.

concepts.name: Redox Reactions
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Oxidation states, and electron transfer in oxidation-reduction reactions.
learning_objectives: Balance redox reactions and identify oxidizing and reducing agents.

concepts.name: Electrochemistry
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Galvanic cells, electrolysis, and the relationship between chemical and electrical energy.
learning_objectives: Calculate cell potentials for galvanic cells from standard reduction potentials.

concepts.name: Introduction to Organic Chemistry
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: The structure and naming of basic hydrocarbon compounds.
learning_objectives: Name and draw structures for simple hydrocarbon compounds.

concepts.name: Functional Groups
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Common functional groups and how they determine molecular reactivity.
learning_objectives: Identify common functional groups and predict their general reactivity.
